flashcard_questions.q: What does the word incarnation literally mean?
What does the incarnation mean in Christian belief?
flashcard_questions.a: God became human in the person of Jesus Christ.

flashcard_questions.q: Which verse says “The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us”?
What does calling Jesus the Son of God mean?
flashcard_questions.a: He shares God’s divine nature and has existed with the Father eternally.

flashcard_questions.q: What did the voice from heaven say at Jesus’s baptism?
flashcard_questions.a: This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased.

flashcard_questions.q: Which creed states “God from God, Light from Light, true God from true God”?
Who sentenced Jesus to death by crucifixion?
On which day of the week did Jesus die?
flashcard_questions.a: Friday, now commemorated as Good Friday.

flashcard_questions.q: What did Jesus pray before his arrest?
flashcard_questions.a: Not my will, but yours be done.

flashcard_questions.q: Why do Christians believe Jesus’s death was a perfect sacrifice?
flashcard_questions.a: He was sinless, so his death could pay the price for human sin.

flashcard_questions.q: What did the angel tell the women at the empty tomb?
flashcard_questions.a: He is not here; he has risen!

flashcard_questions.q: Which verse says “If Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile”?
Why do Christians worship on a Sunday?
flashcard_questions.a: It is the day Jesus rose from the dead.

flashcard_questions.q: How long after the resurrection did Jesus ascend to heaven?
Where do Christians believe Jesus sits after the ascension?
flashcard_questions.a: At the right hand of the Father.

notes: 15 cards: 4 term→definition (incarnation literal and doctrinal, Son of God, Nicene Creed), 4 belief→source (John 1:14, Matthew 3:17, 1 Corinthians 15:17, Matthew 28:6), 3 event/date facts (Pilate, Good Friday, forty days), 4 cause→effect (perfect sacrifice, Sunday worship, right hand, Gethsemane prayer).
